summary: Regression-verified the single-BrowserRouter fix (main.tsx holds BrowserRouter with basename; App.tsx has none). Full frontend flow tested via Playwright against the public URL: unauth redirects, login, all 12 sidebar SPA navigations, nested student profile, direct URL entry for every route, logout, and post-logout auth guard. Zero console errors, zero 'You cannot render a <Router> inside another <Router>' warnings, and SPA navigation confirmed (window marker preserved across all clicks = no full page reload).
critical_code_review_comments: Review request referenced sidebar test-ids as [data-testid=sidebar-link-*] using route slugs (e.g., sidebar-link-dashboard, sidebar-link-students, sidebar-link-walkins, sidebar-link-admissions, sidebar-link-batches, sidebar-link-registration). Actual test-ids use the sidebar label slug (sidebar-link-main-dashboard, sidebar-link-student-walk-ins, sidebar-link-student-registration, sidebar-link-students, sidebar-link-admission-and-fees, sidebar-link-batch-management, ...). Not a bug, but the mismatch will confuse future testers/agents. Recommend standardising sidebar-link-* to the route slug so external test IDs stay stable independent of copy changes.
Logout test-id is 'sidebar-logout-button', not 'sidebar-logout' — same drift concern as above.
auth is only sessionStorage — existing code comment already flags this as demo-only, acceptable.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / password123 (any non-empty pair works; sessionStorage['sms.auth']='1' also authenticates)
seed_data_creation: None. DataStore is in-memory React Context; used the built-in seeded student STU-2026-00125 to verify nested route.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar data-testids use label slugs, not route slugs. Reference list: sidebar-link-main-dashboard, sidebar-link-student-walk-ins, sidebar-link-student-registration, sidebar-link-students, sidebar-link-admission-and-fees, sidebar-link-batch-management, sidebar-link-employees, sidebar-link-attendance, sidebar-link-class-reports, sidebar-link-tasks, sidebar-link-performance, sidebar-link-reports. Logout = sidebar-logout-button. Sidebar is inside AppLayout (only visible on authed routes). To bootstrap authed session in Playwright without form submit: sessionStorage.setItem('sms.auth','1') then navigate to /dashboard.
